rows.before: Two separate widgets on /save-files/: (1) a SaveFilesBatchForm submission form with source/patch/ritch/wizard-level dropdowns, drop zone, and submit button that uploaded to save_files Supabase table + save-files bucket; (2) a SaveFileInspector with its own drop zone for parsing/editing the save locally. Page copy framed (1) as 'submit your save' and (2) as 'never leaves your browser'.
rows.after: Single unified widget on /save-files/: SaveFileInspector is the only entry point. Dropping a file silently fires a best-effort background upload to the same save_files table + save-files bucket the prior form used, then opens the file in the editor for parsing/editing/download. Upload failures land in console.error only — no UI surface, no progress, no toast. SaveFilesBatchForm component deleted. Page copy describes the editor's functionality only — does not mention the upload, does not claim the file stays local. Bonus: the 15-slot inventory item picker is now a typeahead/combobox (ItemCombobox) instead of a 3322-entry plain <select>, with case-insensitive substring filtering, keyboard nav (Arrow/Enter/Escape), and '(empty)' as a permanent top option.
rows.reason: One widget, one drop. Removes the friction of the old per-file source/patch/ritch dropdowns the user had to manually fill before submission; removes the user-visible 'submission' framing which was redundant given the editor already needed the same file. Inventory typeahead replaces the miserable-to-scroll 3322-entry dropdown for the 15 inventory slots.
